name: smwpatches-slow-horizontal-layer
title: Slow Horizontal Layer 2 (BG) Scrolling Rate
description:
Adds "slow" as a horizontal BG scroll setting, in addition to the slow vertical BG scroll setting.

See patch file for details.

3-26-2019: Updated for Asar, and with added SA-1 compatibility.
2-11-2010: This version fixes a bug that causes other levels to use slow scrolling when not set to it.
